title: ポッシビリティの汁物

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, Seeking the Pearl and I are walking through the shopping district on our way back from an outing when…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Sniff, sniff… Hmm, what's that lovely aroma? It smells like mellow, well-aged miso.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text: Hey there, miss! You've got a good nose on ya! I got some top-notch miso delivered just the other day. Wanna buy a package and try some?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Sure, I'll take one! With that rich, full-bodied aroma, it's clearly been aged to perfection. I bet you could make a fabulous bowl of miso soup with it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's hurry and test out my intuition! I know a good place where we can do just that. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To make the miso soup, we head to a nearby public barbecue area.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Eating miso soup out in the open air is bound to be a très bien experience!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wowee! Howdy, you two! What're the odds I'd find y'all here?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: You've come at the right time, Taiki. I'm just about to make some miso soup!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Pardon? But isn't this spot for barbecuin'? What're you doin', makin' miso soup out here?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. Didn't you know? Miso soup is a go-to dish when camping! And do you know why that is?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It's because miso paste is made of soybeans, which can help lower your cholesterol!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: What's more, the enzymes in miso help with digestion!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's like a miracle food! I had no idea!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It truly is a food with unlimited hidden possibilities. It's a wonder why it isn't eaten all over the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: So, how about it? Would you like a bowl?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That there sure is a temptin' offer, but seein' as I've done eaten 'bout two days worth of meat, I don't think I could even hold down a single sip.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's no reason to give up. Here, close your eyes for a moment… Start the music!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After closing my eyes and concentrating on the relaxing music, an image begins to pop into my mind!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, can ya see it too, Trainer? This is gettin' kinda exciting, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's summon the souls of the ingredients with the music! First, let's begin with the tofu—the angel in the world of miso!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Slice it with a smile. ♪ Warm it up all the way through! You're going to be nice and velvety smooth!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Next is the wakame seaweed, which is brimming with calcium and magnesium! Let those nutrients seep right in the broth! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Time to let the broth dance and mingle in the pot! ♪ Let the umami burst forth!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: And now it's time for a mash-up between the broth and the miso! ♪ Hand in hand, they raise the game!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Wow, the miso smells excellent! My tummy may be full but my mouth's startin' to water…
choice_data_list: Is it almost done? I can't wait to have some!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, your excitement seems to be matching the ingredients'.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We're not quite there yet! Crank up that passion! The secret to really enjoying miso soup is to get pumped up!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yahoo! Miso soup is THE BEST!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Really feel your body's craving for the soup! C'mon, you too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That's it! Ahh, it's starting to boil! Show that miso soup just how excited you are!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Here we gooo!

text_block_list.name: Pearl and Taiki
text_block_list.text: WOO-HOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hmmm… It's so weird. I thought I was full, but…

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: This soup is so good, I can't stop drinking it! It's comforting, and goes down so smoothly! ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: That must mean you've synced up nicely with the miso soup. See, doesn't it taste amazing?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: It's so delicious, I feel like I could have another million helpings! ♪ The flavor of miso soup sure is deep an' complex!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, I'm glad you understand the wonder of miso soup!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Miso soup—the superfood that deserves to be known across the world!
choice_data_list: We need to spread the word!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Exactly! Let's share the wonder of miso soup with everyone and make it a beloved food around the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Let's keep exploring new ways to make it, uncover more possibilities, and continue polishing our skill in the art of making miso soup!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl starts making multiple batches of miso soup to explore as many possibilities as she can.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: It wasn't something I learned. I just instinctively season the soup based on who I'm serving, so it never tastes the same twice.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: However, the flavor is all the more meaningful precisely because it's a once-in-a-lifetime experience. Come, let's savor this chance encounter to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl takes a sip of the miso soup and relishes it with a calm, almost saintly expression.
